Mr. Rakesh Sony began his career as an investment banker in Calcutta, helping mid-sized companies raise capital from the capital markets and financial institutions. In 2008, he moved to Mumbai as a founding partner of Motilal Oswal Private Equity, where, over eight years, he led investments in more than 15 companies and helped several of them grow into leaders in their industries — a run that saw the fund recognized as India’s best mid- market private equity fund in 2012.
